lines.text: Wicked usurpers surround the psalmist and trust in their wealth, but no man can pay God a ransom for his brother.
The foolish and senseless perish and leave their wealth to others, and their cities are their eternal homes.
The foolish are like sheep headed for Sheol with Death as their shepherd, but God will redeem the psalmist's life.
A rich man carries nothing away when he dies and joins the generation of Noah.
